description: This file defines the Size class in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides static methods for calculating the nth largest and nth smallest values in a dataset, namely the large() and small() methods, which are implementations of corresponding spreadsheet functions.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate the nth largest and smallest values within a dataset for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: large
methods.description: Returns the nth largest value in a data set, similar to the Excel LARGE function.

methods.name: small
methods.description: Returns the nth smallest value in a data set, similar to the Excel SMALL function.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters an array of arguments to include only numeric values, used internally for processing.
